next.reason: 1985 allows SIGN on a group only if the group contains 'at least one such numeric data description entry' (signed, PICTURE with S). 2023 §2023:13.18.52.3 SR1 allows it on 'an alphanumeric group item, national group item, or strongly-typed group item' with no such condition, and §2023:13.18.52.4 GR1 'applies only to numeric items whose picture character-string contains the symbol' S, so a group with no signed item is now accepted with no effect. Screen entries are new; report group entries were already allowed in the 1985 Report Writer module.
